mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals accommodative monetary policy that compresses equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 4.5% signals labor market deterioration that triggers risk-off sentiment, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 4.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales (HOUST and RSAFS) signal broad consumer demand contraction, driving negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Manufacturing output growth exceeding 0.5% monthly (INDPRO) signals supply-side expansion that boosts corporate profits, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO growth > 0.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate exceeding 5.0% signals aggressive monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 5.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Continued growth in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals labor market strength that supports corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS grows, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent increases in federal funds rate and CPI inflation (FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL) signal inflationary monetary tightening that depresses equity valuations over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL rise, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Post-recession recovery phase (evidenced by rising HOUST and RSAFS) signals rebounding consumer demand that boosts corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods during post-recession recovery when HOUST and RSAFS rise, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year windows.
